ITEM 1 | Whole dark red grapes, about 35 pieces, smooth glossy taut skin, round, about 1.5-2 cm in diameter, scattered in a loose cluster across the upper-right half of the plate, no cut surfaces | 160
ITEM 2 | Three whole pale yellow-green grapes, smooth glossy skin, about 2 cm in diameter, mixed among the red grapes in the cluster | 15
ITEM 3 | Orange-salmon melon pieces, about 10 irregular wedge or cube pieces roughly 3-4 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, smooth cut faces with slightly soft edges, matte to faintly damp surface, lying on the left and lower half of the plate | 110
ITEM 4 | One whole apple, about 7.5-8 cm in diameter, glossy red skin with yellow-green patches and a visible stem cavity on top, firm and intact, resting on the right side of the plate beside the melon pieces | 180
